instruction:
Inspect the workflow files under python/cpython .github/workflows. Identify the workflow responsible for running the main test suite on pull requests. Report its file path, workflow name, trigger events, declared permissions, operating-system
    matrix, Python-version matrix if present, and exact test command. Then identify the separate documentation workflow and report its file path and triggers. Stopping condition: stop after both workflows and every requested configuration field have been
    verified directly from their YAML files. Constraints: stay within public GitHub pages; do not sign in; do not edit or download files; distinguish absent fields from fields that are present but empty.
